requiredBehavior: The original PREPARED native path accepts empty name/MIME and omits them in FileInfo. An absent field matches only expected empty; present values must be strings with exact UTF8 bytes. Null, all other types, missing nonempty expectations and nonempty mismatches remain writeUncertain.
implementation: One nested pure matcher inside the existing metadata validator. Required fileID/objectID/size, content digest, original request/source key/intent, current lease/authority, journal completion and ACK are byte-identical.

tests.assertionScope: Original pure readback validator accepts absent or explicit empty values and one-sided omission; rejects both nonempty missing expectations, six wrong JSON types for each optional, unexpected nonempty values and every missing required field.

integration.originalTargetMembership: App61 source filenames unchanged; this same existing NativePreparation source receives a new whole-file hash. No target/PBX/profile/controller or build dispatch.
integration.futureCompilerRequirement: Only a product whose actual compiler/FileList includes these final source bytes can qualify the new method. The new whole test hash must be explicitly bound at the future freeze; no automatic old-product reuse.
integration.nativeIntentReplay: No new or repeated prepare/commit dispatch is added; this only reconciles supported empty metadata after the original known intent commit.

sourceReviewLimits: No Swift parser/typecheck, candidate import, test run, native account/RPC, host action, Git publication or source-retention gate execution.
